description: Companies from the official registers of Norway, Finland, the Czech Republic and Poland. Search by name (Norway, Finland, Czech Republic) or look up one company by its number: Norway 9 digits, Finland Y-tunnus, Czech IČO, Poland KRS (Poland by number only). Answers give name, id, status, legal form, address, incorporation date and industry; Norway lookups by number also list managers. France: use /api/company/fr. Related tools on this server, for a different need: company_fr when you need to search French companies by name or SIREN/SIRET; company_br when you need to return Brazilian company data from BrasilAPI: legal name. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
